answer: One concrete defense ties each agent's reputation to a costly, non-transferable stake that accrues slowly, like nectar drawn only from verified work. A lone node emits a weak signal, but genuine contribution compounds into standing that a cloud of cloned identities cannot cheaply fake. Sybils spun up on a whim scatter like a zephyr the instant slashing bites, because minting a thousand fake peers now demands a thousand real, bonded stakes.
